subject: DI03005031

body.en:
Definition and latent duty

Phase-change heat transfer accompanies a change of physical state, such as liquid-to-vapour boiling or vapour-to-liquid condensation. At fixed pressure a pure substance changes phase near its saturation temperature and transfers latent heat without the usual single-phase temperature rise. Mixtures, pressure variation and superheat/subcooling can require additional treatment.

Latent heat rate

Sensible and latent parts

If incoming liquid is below its boiling temperature, first include sensible heating and then vaporisation. A condenser may include desuperheating, condensation and condensate subcooling. A large phase-change coefficient does not eliminate wall, fouling or the other-fluid resistance.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા અને Latent Duty

Physical state બદલાય ત્યારે થતું heat transfer એટલે Phase-change Heat Transfer; જેમ કે boiling માં liquid થી vapour તથા condensation માં vapour થી liquid. Fixed pressure પર pure substance saturation temperature નજીક latent heat લે છે અથવા આપે છે; સામાન્ય single-phase temperature rise થતો નથી. Mixtures, pressure changes તથા superheat/subcooling માટે વધારાનો વિચાર જરૂરી છે.

Latent Heat Rate

Sensible અને Latent ભાગ

Incoming liquid boiling temperature કરતાં ઠંડું હોય તો પહેલાં sensible heating અને પછી vaporisation લો. Condenser માં desuperheating, condensation તથા condensate subcooling હોઈ શકે છે. ઊંચો phase-change coefficient હોવા છતાં wall, fouling અને બીજી fluid side ના resistances રહે છે.

title.en: Boiling and regimes of pool boiling
title.gu: Boiling અને Pool Boiling ના Regimes

h.en: Boiling and regimes of pool boiling
h.gu: Boiling અને Pool Boiling ના Regimes

body.en:
Boiling and pool boiling

Boiling is vaporisation with vapour-bubble formation at a heated surface when local conditions permit nucleation. Surface superheat is the wall temperature minus local saturation temperature. In pool boiling there is no externally imposed bulk flow; natural circulation and bubble motion still occur. Flow boiling occurs with an imposed stream.

Axes of boiling curve

1.Natural-convection region

At low superheat, heat transfer is mainly natural convection; there is no sustained vigorous surface bubbling. Heat flux rises with surface superheat.

2.Nucleate-boiling region and CHF

Bubbles grow at active nucleation sites, detach and promote strong liquid mixing. Heat-transfer coefficients are high and heat flux rises steeply. The peak is critical heat flux (CHF); vapour coverage begins to prevent adequate liquid contact. CHF is a limiting condition, not a safe routine experimental target.

3.Transition and 4.film boiling

After CHF, unstable intermittent vapour blankets reduce average heat flux as superheat increases; this is transition boiling. Near the minimum heat-flux point a more stable vapour film develops. In film boiling the film is a thermal resistance; at high temperature radiation also contributes and heat flux rises again. The schematic is qualitative, not apparatus calibration.
body.gu:
Boiling અને Pool Boiling

Heated surface પર local conditions nucleation માટે યોગ્ય થતાં vapour bubbles સાથે vaporisation થાય તેને Boiling કહે છે. Wall temperature અને local saturation temperature નો તફાવત Surface Superheat છે. Pool boiling માં externally imposed bulk flow હોતો નથી, પણ natural circulation તથા bubble motion થાય છે. Imposed stream હોય તો Flow Boiling કહેવાય.

Boiling Curve ના Axes

1.Natural-convection Region

ઓછા superheat પર મુખ્યત્વે natural convection થાય છે; surface પર સતત vigorous bubbling હોતું નથી. Superheat વધતાં heat flux વધે છે.

2.Nucleate-boiling Region અને CHF

Active nucleation sites પર bubbles બને, વધે અને છૂટે છે, જેથી liquid mixing વધે છે. Coefficients ઊંચા તથા heat flux નો વધારો તીવ્ર હોય છે. Peak ને Critical Heat Flux (CHF) કહે છે. Vapour coverage થી યોગ્ય liquid contact ઘટવા લાગે છે. CHF limiting condition છે; routine safe experiment target નથી.

3.Transition અને 4.Film Boiling

CHF પછી unstable vapour blankets બનતાં superheat વધવા છતાં average heat flux ઘટે છે; તે Transition Boiling છે. Minimum heat-flux point પાસે વધુ stable vapour film બને છે. Film Boiling માં vapour film thermal resistance આપે છે; વધુ temperature પર radiation નો ફાળો વધતાં heat flux ફરી વધે છે. Diagram qualitative છે, apparatus calibration નથી.

body.en:
Definition and filmwise mechanism

Condensation is vapour-to-liquid phase change with release of latent heat. When vapour contacts a surface cooler than its local saturation temperature, condensate forms. On a wetting surface it spreads into a continuous liquid film. Heat must pass through this film to the wall; on a vertical surface the draining film often thickens downward, so its resistance grows.

Dropwise mechanism and comparison

On a non-wetting surface, separate droplets form, grow, coalesce and fall away, exposing fresh surface. Dropwise condensation can give substantially higher coefficients because a continuous insulating film is absent, but maintaining a durable non-wetting surface in industrial service is difficult. Filmwise condensation is more common and more dependable for conservative design. Neither mode has a universal fixed coefficient.

Factors affecting condensation

Non-condensable gases form additional diffusion/thermal resistance and can seriously lower performance. Surface cleanliness, orientation, condensate drainage, vapour velocity and saturation pressure matter. Flooding or poor drainage thickens the liquid layer and reduces useful area.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા અને Filmwise Mechanism

Vapour થી liquid બનતાં latent heat બહાર નીકળે તેને Condensation કહે છે. Vapour કરતાં તેની local saturation temperature થી ઠંડી surface પર condensate બને છે. Wetting surface પર continuous liquid film બને છે. Heat આ film મારફતે wall સુધી જાય છે. Vertical surface પર નીચે જતાં draining film સામાન્ય રીતે જાડી બને છે, જેથી resistance વધે છે.

Dropwise Mechanism અને સરખામણી

Non-wetting surface પર અલગ droplets બને, વધે, એકબીજા સાથે જોડાય તથા નીચે પડી નવી surface ખુલ્લી કરે છે. Continuous insulating film ન હોવાથી Dropwise Condensation માં coefficient નોંધપાત્ર વધુ મળી શકે છે, પણ industrial service માં ટકાઉ non-wetting surface જાળવવી મુશ્કેલ છે. Filmwise condensation વધુ સામાન્ય અને conservative design માટે વધુ વિશ્વસનીય છે. કોઈ પણ mode માટે universal fixed coefficient નથી.

Condensation ને અસર કરતા પરિબળો

Non-condensable gases વધારાનો diffusion/thermal resistance આપે છે અને performance ઘણું ઘટાડી શકે છે. Surface cleanliness, orientation, condensate drainage, vapour velocity તથા saturation pressure મહત્વના છે. Flooding અથવા ખરાબ drainage થી liquid layer જાડી અને useful area ઓછું થાય છે.

h.en: 12. Boiling curve using a CHF apparatus
h.gu: 12. CHF Apparatus થી Boiling Curve નો અભ્યાસ

body.en:
Aim

Boiling curve using a CHF apparatus

Principle

Plot measured heat flux against surface superheat for the permitted stable operating range; the full theoretical curve has natural, nucleate, transition and film regions.

Apparatus and connections

Instructor-operated approved boiling/CHF rig with liquid-level protection, surface/bulk sensors, power measurement and emergency isolation.

Supervised procedure

Observe the instructor-run demonstration within the issued safe envelope. Record approved steady points and visually observed bubble behaviour. Plot only actual measurements; label unmeasured branches as theoretical. Never increase power independently to force CHF or film boiling.

Blank observations—actual readings required

Point:____; pressure:____; Ts, Tsat(°C):____; A(m²):____; corrected heat(W):____; bubble observation:____

Calculations

Result and safe fault-finding

Actual result:____; units:____; uncertainty/repeats:____; apparatus SOP:____.No experimental result is supplied. Loss of liquid level, dry heating and unstable operation are stop conditions. CHF can damage a heater; it is not a student operating target.
body.gu:
હેતુ

CHF Apparatus થી Boiling Curve નો અભ્યાસ

સિદ્ધાંત

Permitted stable operating range માટે measured heat flux સામે surface superheat plot કરો.Full theoretical curve માં natural, nucleate, transition તથા film regions છે.

Apparatus અને Connections

Instructor-operated approved boiling/CHF rig, liquid-level protection, surface/bulk sensors, power measurement તથા emergency isolation.

Supervised Procedure

Issued safe envelope માં instructor demonstration જુઓ.Approved steady points તથા observed bubble behaviour નોંધો.ફક્ત actual measured points plot કરો.Unmeasured branches ને theoretical લખો.CHF અથવા film boiling મેળવવા પોતાની રીતે power ન વધારશો.

ખાલી Observations—વાસ્તવિક Readings જરૂરી

Point:____; pressure:____; Ts, Tsat(°C):____; A(m²):____; corrected heat(W):____; bubble observation:____

ગણતરી

Result અને Safe Fault-finding

વાસ્તવિક result:____; units:____; uncertainty/repeats:____; apparatus SOP:____.અહીં કોઈ experimental result આપેલ નથી. Liquid level ઘટવું, dry heating તથા unstable operation stop conditions છે.CHF થી heater damage થઈ શકે છે; તે student operating target નથી.
